findings.text: follow-on: the narrowing is guarded only incidentally and by ambient state. No test asserts that a supplied runner suppresses the surface read (git grep read_account_surface over tests/ finds only the stub class at tests/test_crew_lanes_view.py:257), and the two ids that redden when the read is reinstated (tests/test_budget.py:2054, :2093) pass only while the box's own account answers, as the manifest's own positive control concedes; on a host whose account read fails, the reinstated read leaves both green, so a revert is silent there.

follow-on: the suite-wide guard that keeps tests off a live account replaces only reckon._backends.run_probe, so the claude dialect's read_account_surface is unguarded across the suite; that blind spot is what let the pre-narrowed code reach the workstation's own account inside a test process, and it survives this change - a test written tomorrow against a claude-dialect backend can read the live account again.

follow-on: the commit message and the fragment both state that no production call site passes a probe runner, and this one does - preflight is called with probe_runner=lambda _: {} whenever cached_only is set, and reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:240 and :555 set it; under the narrowing a cached_only preflight whose record carries surface_opt_in no longer reads the account surface (budget.py:1272 reaches the probe by that clause with budget_check already forced false). The direction looks right for a flag named cached_only, but the behaviour of a production path changed under a claim that it did not.

follow-on: the narrowing suppresses only the live surface read, not the on-disk copy, so the manifest's stated invariant that an injected runner is the only instrument a caller gets is broader than the code: a caller passing both a runner and a cache_path is still answered from the cache at reckon/_backends.py:2508-2513 before the runner is consulted. No call site passes both today (reckon/mcp_views.py:447 passes a cache path and no runner; reckon/budget.py:1274 passes a runner and no cache path), so this is a latent reachability rather than a live defect.

follow-on: the fragment states the narrowed arm's base and head counts but names no revision for either, and the head arm's own log header reads '323baeda3 + the runner narrowing carried in reckon/_backends.py (uncommitted at run time)', so the figure the fragment quotes cannot be reproduced from git; the armed baseline_suite/after_suite fields in the manifest name 4b43bb5e and 4088c6913, both earlier than the narrowing, leaving the two gained commits measured only by a session-local tree.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 323baeda3 - 24ce8f4d (fix: read no account surface behind an injected probe runner) changes 11 lines of reckon/_backends.py:2497-2507, replacing the unconditional dialect.read_account_surface call with a None when runner is not None and fetch is None; 65f15e69 (docs: record the two ids the population added and the rule kept) adds 20 lines of evidence prose to the fragment. No test file and no assertion is added or changed by either commit.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is the plan's section-8 bullets plus a live request, the published document after one timer pass, arms over every importing test file run with pytest -n 8 adding no failure, five-alone repeats for any id failing in one arm only, and the ruff clause; the manifest records the narrowed arm pair (log-lr-arm-base.log 2 failed / 68 passed EXIT=1 at f976a31d, log-lr-arm-head-narrowed.log 2 failed / 76 passed EXIT=1 with the same two pre-existing CLI ids, so zero added), the declared negative control re-applied (log-negative-control-narrowed.log 1 failed / 7 passed EXIT=1 on the all-unknown case) and per-id five-alone logs; the timer-pass item is recorded as the coordinator's, not claimed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make the claude account readable again by keeping the probe's reason, reading the endpoint that answers and probing an all-unknown account; the two gained commits do not re-do that work but narrow the reader it added - reckon/_backends.py:2497 now returns no live account reading when the caller supplies a probe runner and no fetch - and the account still reads on the operator's path (no production caller passes a runner, but see the cached_only call site at reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:831, which does).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, the narrowed arm pair and its counts stated in the checkpoint and note, the negative control named at log-negative-control-narrowed.log with its failing id quoted, follow_ons naming the two test_budget ids decided as rules kept, and blockers naming the pre-existing CLI pair and the coordinator-owned timer pass; the armed baseline_suite/after_suite JSON names revisions 4b43bb5e and 4088c6913 with exit_status 0 and empty failure_ids, neither of which is the head that carries the narrowing.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node was fenced to reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, reckon/_backends.py, tests/test_the_claude_account_is_read_again.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-limit-reset-reaches-every-session/the-claude-account-is-read-again.html and docs/figures/a-limit-reset-reaches-every-session/the-claude-account-is-read-again; the two gained commits write only reckon/_backends.py and that fragment, both inside the fence (the earlier round's out-of-scope test and fixture writes were already recorded by the prior review and are not part of this diff).

justifications.durability: no assertion is added by either commit, and the only ids that redden on a revert - tests/test_budget.py:2054 and :2093 through the beta backend's claude-dialect surface read - redden only when the box's own logged-in account answers, so on a host where that read fails the reinstated live read leaves both green.
justifications.evidence: log-lr-arm-head-narrowed.log records 2 failed / 76 passed EXIT=1, the same two ids as log-lr-arm-base.log (2 failed / 68 passed EXIT=1), so zero added, and log-negative-control-narrowed.log fails the one declared case; but no arm names the sha that carries the change - the head arm's own header reads '323baeda3 + the runner narrowing carried in reckon/_backends.py (uncommitted at run time)' - and the manifest's armed baseline_suite/after_suite name 4b43bb5e and 4088c6913, so the armed fields do not cover the two gained commits.
justifications.fit: the added condition follows the funnel's unknown-else-read idiom and its comment at reckon/_backends.py:2498-2502 states the mechanism rather than a ticket or a plan label, and no version suffix, ordering label or author attribution appears in the gained diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:2497-2507 suppresses the live account read behind an injected runner, which is the defect the node's own tests were resting on, and the account read the node built is left intact for the callers that reach it, so the goal holds without being extended.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no new definition, so nothing forks an owned capability, but the repository already owns the mechanism that keeps tests off a live account - the suite guard at tests/conftest.py:415, which patches only _backends.run_probe - and the fix narrows production code instead of extending that guard to the read_account_surface seam it does not cover.
justifications.scope_discipline: the gained diff writes exactly reckon/_backends.py and the node's own evidence fragment, both inside the node's five fenced paths, and adds no behaviour the goal does not imply.
